definitions.full: H8319. sharaq שָׁרַק verb hiss , perhaps also whistle, pipe (Late Hebrew id., hiss (dubious), Aramaic שְׁרֵיק id. ᵑ7 Lev 2:15-16 , id. ; — from ׳שׁ comes Greek σῦριγξ according to Lag Abh GGW xxvi. 38 Lewy Fremdw.165 ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular consecutive ׳וְשׁ Isa 5:26 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁרֹק 7:18 + ( Job 27:23 read יִשְׁרְקוּ Me Bi Siegf Bu); 1 singular אֶשְׁרְקָה Zech 10:8 ; — hiss , as signal, ל person, figurative, ׳י subject: Isa 5:26 ; 7:18 ; Zech 10:1 ; in derision, עַל civitat., etc. (often + שָׁמֵם be astounded ), Jer 19:8 ; 49:17 ; 50:13 ; Lam 2:15 (+ ראֹשׁ הֵנִיעַ ), Ezek 27:36 ; absolute Zeph 2:15 ; Lam 2:16 ; 1Kin 9:8 (+ שֵׁן חָרַק ); עַל person Job 27:23 (with מִן local). שׁרק ( שְׁרֵיק ᵑ7 , Syriac , Biblical Hebrew שָׁרַק hiss, whistle (onomatopoetic).
